Name: (CP) Darker Floors
Author: Tiyara
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I needed some darker floors to make some brightly-coloured furniture pieces pop, so I took some original floorings and re-coloured them. This also accidentally (moved one slider to the wrong end) created one bright orange tile that just tickled my happy neurons so I kept it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation Requirements & instructions[/b][/size]
You need SMAPI, Content Patcher and the catalogue. Unzip the downloaded file into your mods folder and you should find these floors in your catalog next time you start the game.
